unsupported_claims: node2vec's second-order biased random walks with return parameter p and in-out parameter q, as described, are not in the evidence beyond the mention of (p,q) settings.
The skip-gram objective sum over u of log Pr(N_S(u)|f(u)) and the softmax formula with conditional independence and symmetry assumptions are not in the evidence.
Output-side context embeddings in the softmax or negative-sampling layer are not in the evidence.
rationale: The answer correctly rejects the false premise and says node2vec learns latent vertex representations. The evidence is mostly DeepWalk text, so node2vec-specific details such as the objective, softmax form, and context embeddings are not shown in it, though they are accurate background from the node2vec paper. The core correction is supported.
